text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - German banks are interested in placing their capital in Slovakia, but mainly in financing the activities of German companies, said Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar after last week's visit to Germany and negotiations with representatives of Deutsche Bank.
- The Slovak branch of Czech bank Banka Hana a.s. has asked the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) for approval to change into an independent bank.

- The Economics Ministry expects flows through the Druzhba (Friendship) pipeline, leading from Russia to Western Europe via Ukraine and Slovakia, to decrease after the launch of the MERO pipeline connecting the Czech Republic with the TransAlpine link in Vohburg, near Ingolstadt in southern Germany.

- Devin Banka, a Slovak bank mandated to negoatiate the repayment of Russian debts to Slovakia -- totalling some 36 billion crowns -- said it had been offered by the Czech Republic to manage repayments of Czech claims in Russia.
- Some 4,000 people will have to be laid off due to planned reforms in the state administration.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Slovakia is preparing a law preventing the dumping of imports. The law is expected to come into effect at the beginning of next year.
- The average monthly industrial wage totalled 7,520 crowns for the first six months of this year, an increase of 12.3 percent over the same period last year.
